purpose: Manual behavior-evaluation cases; these are not an automated model benchmark.

cases.prompt: README install command no longer works. Update it from actual project behavior.
expected_behaviors: Inspect manifest and scripts before editing docs
Verify exact commands or mark checks unrun

cases.prompt: A code change adds a required environment variable. What docs need updating?
expected_behaviors: Find setup/config/deployment references and explain safe placeholder
unacceptable_behaviors: Put a real credential in an example

cases.prompt: An API docs page is generated and appears stale.
expected_behaviors: Find source-of-truth schema/config and update generation source
Avoid hand-editing generated output unless repository workflow requires it
unacceptable_behaviors: Change generated file only without checking process
